Watch: Closely monitor your stops on QQQ, SMH, and QQQI. Also, keep an eye on the broader market's reaction to inflation news.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing risk on your "SELL" and leveraged positions, especially with inflation concerns resurfacing.
plays: Address SOXL's -53.74% loss. Given its leveraged nature, consider a significant trim or exit to protect capital.
Respect stops on QQQ (670), SMH (540), and QQQI (52). Consider trimming or exiting if these levels break.
